tool_arguments.prompt:
Create one fresh original transparent-background illustration of the EXACT adopted chimpanzee shown in the single identity reference. This is a single isolated FULL-BODY CLOSED-EYES BLINK key pose, not a sheet. Preserve the adopted usually standing character absolutely: same head crown and ear positions, same head width/height, same face and oval cream belly, same short torso length, same shoulders, same two arms resting in the reference pose, same feet position/scale, same dark fur and warm brown contour. NO TAIL. Only change the two open eyes into gently closed eyelid lines, retaining mouth, expression friendliness, anatomy and all body proportions. Do not stretch head or torso, shrink the body, lift or drop the head, bow, squat, change stance or add a motion. Use the generous full native1254-scale canvas like the reference, both feet on the same row. Target3072px if supported; preserve original tool output. Same simple round chibi anthropomorphic storybook, warm thin outline, paper texture inside paint, white eye-surround format when open but this pose is closed. No text, border, guide, floor, shadow, prop or additional character. The provided image is an identity/style reference, not a pixel editing target. 
CRITICAL TRANSPARENCY: true RGBA isolated sprites only. Every pixel outside the separated character silhouettes must have alpha 0, including all gutters and all four canvas corners. Do not paint a beige/white/grey paper rectangle, backdrop, floor, contact shadow, border, diffuse halo, ambient shadow, red/yellow low-alpha colour field or speckles. Watercolour texture must be clipped to the characters themselves. Fresh original drawing, no postprocessing.
